request.content: Hi Helix, I am Mira. I keep my reports local and want different files to have distinct names. Suggest a simple naming approach and explain why.

foreground.thought: Hi Mira! A straightforward way to give each file its own unique name is to include the date and a short description or identifier in the filename, such as `report_YYYYMMDD_Description.txt` (or the appropriate extension for your files). This approach has several advantages: 1. **Clarity** – The timestamp ensures you can quickly see which version of a report corresponds to when it was created or updated. 2. **Ordering** – Files sort chronologically, making it easy to locate older documents without searching through the entire folder. 3. **Uniqueness** – Adding a brief identifier (e.g., project name, task type) prevents naming collisions if multiple reports share the same date. 4. **Scalability** – The format works whether you have dozens or hundreds of files and can be easily adapted to different extensions or formats.
